svg.title: Which language a player sees
svg.desc: Chrome gives the extension the texts of its own language. When extension/_locales has that language, English, German, Dutch, French or Spanish, the popup, the switcher in the page, the welcome page, the settings and the tooltip of the icon show it, with names and times in its format; any other language shows English, the default of the manifest. Help leads to the help in that language when the website has it, as for German, and to the English help otherwise.
